method_note: Google News RSS searches across eight publishers. Multiple search phrases are used. Headlines and RSS descriptions are checked. Only explicit trade-style and recommendation wording with recognised stock names is included. Entry, target and stop-loss values are extracted only when visible in the available text. Missing values are not guessed. RSS coverage is not complete and every recommendation requires verification.
